name: WikiMatrix: Mining 135M Parallel Sentences in 1620 Language Pairs
description: WikiMatrix is a massive parallel sentence corpus extracted from Wikipedia across 1,620 language pairs covering 85 different languages. Curated by Facebook AI Research using language-agnostic sentence embeddings (LASER) and margin-based bitext filtering, it comprises 135 million parallel sentence pairs, dramatically expanding parallel training resources for low- and medium-resource language translation.
